settings.title: Hydrawise Settings
settings.pref_intro1: The app can poll for updates to keep Homey synchronised to the devices.
settings.pref_intro2: This puts a load on the Hydrawise servers so keep switched off if possible.
settings.pref_intro3: If you need updates then keep the interval as high as you can and use flows to turn it on/off when needed.
settings.get_api_key: Click here to get an valid API key.

rain_sensor.login_required: Sign in to Hydrawise again using Repair.
rain_sensor.rate_limited: Hydrawise request limit reached. Retrying later.
rain_sensor.invalid_response: Hydrawise did not provide a valid sensor response.
rain_sensor.sensor_unavailable: Controller offline or sensor state unknown.
rain_sensor.different_account: Use the same Hydrawise account as the already paired rain sensors.
